options.content: Pilots: Traffic · New pilots · Origins · Records · Routes · Aircraft · Military | ATC: Overview · Retention · Hours · Positions · **Ranks** | Events: Monday events | Management: Health All times are UTC. Figures cover VATPAC airspace. **Rank here is the controller's CURRENT rank**, the latest rating seen for each CID, so every controller counts once. The older ATC panels use the rank held at the time of each session, so totals on this page will not match them. Ranks included: S1, S2, S3, C1, C3 and I1+ (rating 8 and above). Left out: observers, C2 (not in use) and unknown ratings. Hours are merged-session time with no minimum session length, for the last 30 days.

panels.title: Controllers logged on (last 30 days)
panels.description: Distinct controllers per rating group with more than 60 minutes online in total over the last 30 days. THIS PANEL USES THE RANK AT THE TIME OF EACH SESSION (not the current rank used by the other panels on this page), so it can differ from them; I1+ includes supervisors and administrators (rating 8 and above); observers and C2 are left out. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(sort, rank_group) AS (VALUES (2, 'S1'), (3, 'S2'), (4, 'S3'), (5, 'C1'), (7, 'C3'), (8, 'I1+')),
per_controller AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group, sum(duration_minutes) AS minutes
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY cid, rank_group
  HAVING sum(duration_minutes) > 60
)
SELECT r.rank_group, count(p.cid) AS controllers
FROM ranks r
LEFT JOIN per_controller p ON p.rank_group = r.rank_group
GROUP BY r.sort, r.rank_group
ORDER BY r.sort

panels.title: Controllers logged on each week, by rating group
panels.description: Per calendar week (UTC), distinct controllers per rating group (S1, S2, S3, C1, C3, I1+) whose sessions that week at that rating total more than 60 minutes. THIS PANEL USES THE RANK AT THE TIME OF EACH SESSION (not the current rank used by the other panels on this page); I1+ includes supervisors and administrators (rating 8 and above); observers and C2 are not shown. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', min(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS first_week,
         date_trunc('week', max(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS last_week
  FROM controller_session_ranked
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT g.w AS week_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(
         greatest(b.first_week, date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         least(b.last_week, date_trunc('week', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         interval '1 week') AS g(w)
  WHERE b.first_week IS NOT NULL
),
per_controller AS (
  SELECT m.week_start, s.cid, s.rating
  FROM weeks m
  JOIN controller_session_ranked s
    ON (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= m.week_start
   AND (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  m.week_start + interval '1 week'
  GROUP BY m.week_start, s.cid, s.rating
  HAVING sum(s.duration_minutes) > 60
)
SELECT m.week_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'S1')  AS "S1",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'S2')  AS "S2",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'S3')  AS "S3",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'C1')  AS "C1",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'C3')  AS "C3",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'I1+') AS "I1+"
FROM weeks m
LEFT JOIN per_controller p ON p.week_start = m.week_start
GROUP BY m.week_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Hours staffed by current rank (last 30 days)
panels.description: Hours staffed per rank and the number of different controllers behind them, over the last 30 days. RANK IS THE CURRENT RANK: the latest rating seen for each CID, so every controller counts once, under one rank. The older ATC panels use the rank held at the time of each session, so totals here will not match them. Ranks included: S1, S2, S3, C1, C3 and I1+ (I1+ is rating 8 and above: I1, I2, I3, supervisors and administrators, as on the existing dashboards). Left out: observers (OBS), C2 (not in use) and unknown ratings. Hours are position-hours: the time each position was staffed, from merged controller sessions (a reconnect within 5 minutes is one session), clipped to the period, with no minimum session length; a controller still online counts up to the latest sighting. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(rank_group, sort) AS (VALUES ('S1', 1), ('S2', 2), ('S3', 3), ('C1', 4), ('C3', 5), ('I1+', 6)),
cur AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group_of((array_agg(rating ORDER BY session_end DESC) FILTER (WHERE rating IS NOT NULL))[1]) AS rank_group
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  GROUP BY cid
),
sec AS (
  SELECT s.cid, s.callsign, s.name, s.session_start, c.rank_group,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM least(s.session_end, now()) - greatest(s.session_start, now() - interval '30 days')), 0) AS secs
  FROM controller_session_ranked s JOIN cur c ON c.cid = s.cid
  WHERE s.session_end >= now() - interval '30 days' AND s.session_start <= now()
)
SELECT r.rank_group AS "Rank (current)",
       count(DISTINCT s.cid) FILTER (WHERE s.secs > 0) AS "Controllers",
       round(coalesce(sum(s.secs), 0) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours staffed"
FROM ranks r LEFT JOIN sec s ON s.rank_group = r.rank_group
GROUP BY r.sort, r.rank_group
ORDER BY r.sort

panels.title: Share of ATC hours by current rank (last 30 days)
panels.description: Each rank's share of all ATC hours staffed in the last 30 days. The share is of ALL staffed hours, so the last row, Other, holds the hours of observers, C2 and unknown ratings and the shares add to 100. RANK IS THE CURRENT RANK: the latest rating seen for each CID, so every controller counts once, under one rank. The older ATC panels use the rank held at the time of each session, so totals here will not match them. Ranks included: S1, S2, S3, C1, C3 and I1+ (I1+ is rating 8 and above: I1, I2, I3, supervisors and administrators, as on the existing dashboards). Left out: observers (OBS), C2 (not in use) and unknown ratings. Hours are position-hours: the time each position was staffed, from merged controller sessions (a reconnect within 5 minutes is one session), clipped to the period, with no minimum session length; a controller still online counts up to the latest sighting. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(rank_group, sort) AS (VALUES ('S1', 1), ('S2', 2), ('S3', 3), ('C1', 4), ('C3', 5), ('I1+', 6), ('Other', 7)),
cur AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group_of((array_agg(rating ORDER BY session_end DESC) FILTER (WHERE rating IS NOT NULL))[1]) AS rank_group
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  GROUP BY cid
),
sec AS (
  SELECT s.cid, s.callsign, s.name, s.session_start, c.rank_group,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM least(s.session_end, now()) - greatest(s.session_start, now() - interval '30 days')), 0) AS secs
  FROM controller_session_ranked s JOIN cur c ON c.cid = s.cid
  WHERE s.session_end >= now() - interval '30 days' AND s.session_start <= now()
),
by_rank AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN rank_group IN ('S1', 'S2', 'S3', 'C1', 'C3', 'I1+') THEN rank_group ELSE 'Other' END AS rank_group, sum(secs) AS secs
  FROM sec GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT r.rank_group AS "Rank (current)",
       round(coalesce(b.secs, 0) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours staffed",
       round(100.0 * coalesce(b.secs, 0) / NULLIF((SELECT sum(secs) FROM sec), 0), 1) AS "Share of ATC hours (%)"
FROM ranks r LEFT JOIN by_rank b ON b.rank_group = r.rank_group
ORDER BY r.sort

panels.title: Sessions by current rank (last 30 days)
panels.description: The number of controller sessions that started in the last 30 days, per rank. A session is a merged controller session (a reconnect within 5 minutes is the same session); no minimum length. RANK IS THE CURRENT RANK: the latest rating seen for each CID, so every controller counts once, under one rank. The older ATC panels use the rank held at the time of each session, so totals here will not match them. Ranks included: S1, S2, S3, C1, C3 and I1+ (I1+ is rating 8 and above: I1, I2, I3, supervisors and administrators, as on the existing dashboards). Left out: observers (OBS), C2 (not in use) and unknown ratings. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(rank_group, sort) AS (VALUES ('S1', 1), ('S2', 2), ('S3', 3), ('C1', 4), ('C3', 5), ('I1+', 6)),
cur AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group_of((array_agg(rating ORDER BY session_end DESC) FILTER (WHERE rating IS NOT NULL))[1]) AS rank_group
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  GROUP BY cid
),
ses AS (
  SELECT s.cid, s.callsign, s.name, s.session_start, s.duration_minutes, c.rank_group
  FROM controller_session_ranked s JOIN cur c ON c.cid = s.cid
  WHERE s.session_start >= now() - interval '30 days' AND s.session_start <= now()
)
SELECT r.rank_group AS "Rank (current)", count(s.cid) AS "Sessions"
FROM ranks r LEFT JOIN ses s ON s.rank_group = r.rank_group
GROUP BY r.sort, r.rank_group
ORDER BY r.sort

panels.title: Average session length by current rank (last 30 days)
panels.description: The average length of the sessions that started in the last 30 days, per rank, in minutes and hours; a rank with no sessions shows no average. Full length of each merged session (a reconnect within 5 minutes is the same session); no minimum length. RANK IS THE CURRENT RANK: the latest rating seen for each CID, so every controller counts once, under one rank. The older ATC panels use the rank held at the time of each session, so totals here will not match them. Ranks included: S1, S2, S3, C1, C3 and I1+ (I1+ is rating 8 and above: I1, I2, I3, supervisors and administrators, as on the existing dashboards). Left out: observers (OBS), C2 (not in use) and unknown ratings. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(rank_group, sort) AS (VALUES ('S1', 1), ('S2', 2), ('S3', 3), ('C1', 4), ('C3', 5), ('I1+', 6)),
cur AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group_of((array_agg(rating ORDER BY session_end DESC) FILTER (WHERE rating IS NOT NULL))[1]) AS rank_group
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  GROUP BY cid
),
ses AS (
  SELECT s.cid, s.callsign, s.name, s.session_start, s.duration_minutes, c.rank_group
  FROM controller_session_ranked s JOIN cur c ON c.cid = s.cid
  WHERE s.session_start >= now() - interval '30 days' AND s.session_start <= now()
)
SELECT r.rank_group AS "Rank (current)", count(s.cid) AS "Sessions",
       round(avg(s.duration_minutes)::numeric, 1) AS "Average minutes",
       round(avg(s.duration_minutes)::numeric / 60.0, 2) AS "Average hours"
FROM ranks r LEFT JOIN ses s ON s.rank_group = r.rank_group
GROUP BY r.sort, r.rank_group
ORDER BY r.sort

panels.title: Top 2 positions for each current rank (last 30 days)
panels.description: For each rank, the 2 positions (callsigns) it staffed for the most hours in the last 30 days (up to 12 rows; a rank with fewer positions shows fewer). Ties: callsign A to Z. RANK IS THE CURRENT RANK: the latest rating seen for each CID, so every controller counts once, under one rank. The older ATC panels use the rank held at the time of each session, so totals here will not match them. Ranks included: S1, S2, S3, C1, C3 and I1+ (I1+ is rating 8 and above: I1, I2, I3, supervisors and administrators, as on the existing dashboards). Left out: observers (OBS), C2 (not in use) and unknown ratings. Hours are position-hours: the time each position was staffed, from merged controller sessions (a reconnect within 5 minutes is one session), clipped to the period, with no minimum session length; a controller still online counts up to the latest sighting. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(rank_group, sort) AS (VALUES ('S1', 1), ('S2', 2), ('S3', 3), ('C1', 4), ('C3', 5), ('I1+', 6)),
cur AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group_of((array_agg(rating ORDER BY session_end DESC) FILTER (WHERE rating IS NOT NULL))[1]) AS rank_group
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  GROUP BY cid
),
sec AS (
  SELECT s.cid, s.callsign, s.name, s.session_start, c.rank_group,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM least(s.session_end, now()) - greatest(s.session_start, now() - interval '30 days')), 0) AS secs
  FROM controller_session_ranked s JOIN cur c ON c.cid = s.cid
  WHERE s.session_end >= now() - interval '30 days' AND s.session_start <= now()
),
per AS (
  SELECT rank_group, callsign, sum(secs) AS secs FROM sec GROUP BY rank_group, callsign HAVING sum(secs) > 0
), ordered AS (
  SELECT p.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.rank_group ORDER BY p.secs DESC, p.callsign) AS n FROM per p
)
SELECT r.rank_group AS "Rank (current)", o.n AS "#", o.callsign AS "Position", round(o.secs / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours staffed"
FROM ordered o JOIN ranks r ON r.rank_group = o.rank_group
WHERE o.n <= 2
ORDER BY r.sort, o.n

panels.title: Top 2 controllers for each current rank (last 30 days)
panels.description: For each rank, the 2 controllers with the most hours staffed in the last 30 days (up to 12 rows), with the name from their latest session in the window. Ties: lower CID first. RANK IS THE CURRENT RANK: the latest rating seen for each CID, so every controller counts once, under one rank. The older ATC panels use the rank held at the time of each session, so totals here will not match them. Ranks included: S1, S2, S3, C1, C3 and I1+ (I1+ is rating 8 and above: I1, I2, I3, supervisors and administrators, as on the existing dashboards). Left out: observers (OBS), C2 (not in use) and unknown ratings. Hours are position-hours: the time each position was staffed, from merged controller sessions (a reconnect within 5 minutes is one session), clipped to the period, with no minimum session length; a controller still online counts up to the latest sighting. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(rank_group, sort) AS (VALUES ('S1', 1), ('S2', 2), ('S3', 3), ('C1', 4), ('C3', 5), ('I1+', 6)),
cur AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group_of((array_agg(rating ORDER BY session_end DESC) FILTER (WHERE rating IS NOT NULL))[1]) AS rank_group
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  GROUP BY cid
),
sec AS (
  SELECT s.cid, s.callsign, s.name, s.session_start, c.rank_group,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM least(s.session_end, now()) - greatest(s.session_start, now() - interval '30 days')), 0) AS secs
  FROM controller_session_ranked s JOIN cur c ON c.cid = s.cid
  WHERE s.session_end >= now() - interval '30 days' AND s.session_start <= now()
),
per AS (
  SELECT rank_group, cid, (array_agg(name ORDER BY session_start DESC))[1] AS name, sum(secs) AS secs
  FROM sec GROUP BY rank_group, cid HAVING sum(secs) > 0
), ordered AS (
  SELECT p.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.rank_group ORDER BY p.secs DESC, p.cid) AS n FROM per p
)
SELECT r.rank_group AS "Rank (current)", o.n AS "#", o.name AS "Controller", round(o.secs / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours staffed"
FROM ordered o JOIN ranks r ON r.rank_group = o.rank_group
WHERE o.n <= 2
ORDER BY r.sort, o.n

panels.title: Centre and FSS hours by current rank (last 30 days)
panels.description: Hours staffed on centre (_CTR) and flight service (_FSS) positions per rank in the last 30 days, with each rank's share of all centre and FSS hours (all controllers, including the left-out ranks, so the shares of the six ranks can add to less than 100). Most hours first. RANK IS THE CURRENT RANK: the latest rating seen for each CID, so every controller counts once, under one rank. The older ATC panels use the rank held at the time of each session, so totals here will not match them. Ranks included: S1, S2, S3, C1, C3 and I1+ (I1+ is rating 8 and above: I1, I2, I3, supervisors and administrators, as on the existing dashboards). Left out: observers (OBS), C2 (not in use) and unknown ratings. Hours are position-hours: the time each position was staffed, from merged controller sessions (a reconnect within 5 minutes is one session), clipped to the period, with no minimum session length; a controller still online counts up to the latest sighting. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(rank_group, sort) AS (VALUES ('S1', 1), ('S2', 2), ('S3', 3), ('C1', 4), ('C3', 5), ('I1+', 6)),
cur AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group_of((array_agg(rating ORDER BY session_end DESC) FILTER (WHERE rating IS NOT NULL))[1]) AS rank_group
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  GROUP BY cid
),
sec AS (
  SELECT s.cid, s.callsign, s.name, s.session_start, c.rank_group,
         greatest(extract(epoch FROM least(s.session_end, now()) - greatest(s.session_start, now() - interval '30 days')), 0) AS secs
  FROM controller_session_ranked s JOIN cur c ON c.cid = s.cid
  WHERE s.session_end >= now() - interval '30 days' AND s.session_start <= now()
),
by_rank AS (
  SELECT rank_group,
         sum(secs) FILTER (WHERE callsign ~ '_CTR$') AS ctr, sum(secs) FILTER (WHERE callsign ~ '_FSS$') AS fss
  FROM sec WHERE callsign ~ '_(CTR|FSS)$' GROUP BY rank_group
)
SELECT r.rank_group AS "Rank (current)",
       round(coalesce(b.ctr, 0) / 3600.0, 1) AS "CTR hours",
       round(coalesce(b.fss, 0) / 3600.0, 1) AS "FSS hours",
       round((coalesce(b.ctr, 0) + coalesce(b.fss, 0)) / 3600.0, 1) AS "CTR + FSS hours",
       round(100.0 * (coalesce(b.ctr, 0) + coalesce(b.fss, 0)) / NULLIF((SELECT sum(secs) FROM sec WHERE callsign ~ '_(CTR|FSS)$'), 0), 1) AS "Share of CTR + FSS hours (%)"
FROM ranks r LEFT JOIN by_rank b ON b.rank_group = r.rank_group
ORDER BY coalesce(b.ctr, 0) + coalesce(b.fss, 0) DESC, r.sort
